instruction: For each rule below, declare where it is verified. Use ONLY names from `evidence`. Omit a rule entirely rather than guess - an unresolvable trace is worse than none, because it reports as covered while nothing verifies the rule. Return JSON: { "proposals": [ { "id": "BR-...", "traces": { "ui": [], "api": [], "db": [], "tests": [] } } ] }

rules.text:
- id: BR-REPO-001
    statement: Repo Main tab displays a loan work queue with row-level detail fields for operational triage (Action, Contract State, DPD, Principal Bal., Past Due Bal., Last Pay, Repo Agent, Resident State, Date Assigned, Days with Agent, Last Worked, PTP Date, Region, Assigned To).
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-002
    statement: Each queue row displays the loan reference, customer name, vehicle description (year/make/model), VIN, GPS Installed status, and Serial Number.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-003
    statement: Loan Number is a hyperlink that navigates to the corresponding loan record in the dev3 environment for that loan.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-REPO-004
    statement: Each row displays a disposition label (e.g. No Status, Default Cured, Bankruptcy) reflecting the account's current stage.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-REPO-005
    statement: Each row displays a Repo Type badge (Voluntary Repo or Involuntary Repo).
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-006
    statement: Each row displays the Assigned To representative with assignment date.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-007
    statement: Action is an editable per-row field constrained to the supported action list.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-008
    statement: The Notes icon on a row opens a Notes popup scoped to that loan, showing an Add Note entry field and cross-dashboard Notes History.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-009
    statement: Repo does not perform independent regional routing; an account arrives already assigned via the Assignment Dashboard's routing (assignment.yaml BR-ASGN-009 through BR-ASGN-011).
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-REPO-010
    statement: Assignment and Repo share one combined queueing mechanism — a representative's active queue volume counts accounts on either dashboard as the same single count (assignment.yaml BR-ASGN-012).
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-REPO-011
    statement: Sticky ownership persists through the Repo lifecycle until the repo case is closed or the account reaches one of the final statuses (Secured – Involuntary, Secured – Voluntary, Secured – Impound, or an existing final status such as BK or Unable to Locate) — see assignment.yaml BR-ASGN-013/BR-ASGN-014.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-REPO-012
    statement: When an account reaches a final status and later re-enters the repo process, a new Assignment ID is generated and the account is treated as a new workflow instance, eligible for reassignment using the standard routing rules (assignment.yaml BR-ASGN-015).
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-REPO-013
    statement: Last Worked Date remains associated with the assigned representative; the transition from Assignment to Repo does not reset Last Worked Date, reassign ownership, or create a new Last Worked Date value; subsequent activity continues to update it for that same representative.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-014
    statement: Existing Repo Dashboard prioritization, sorting, and workflow behavior are unchanged by this update; the only workflow change is that regional assignment routing now happens upstream, on the Assignment Dashboard, before an account appears here.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-REPO-015
    statement: Assigned To, Region, Contract State, and Last Worked Date are visible table columns and filters on the Repo Main tab, and a Last Worked > 7 Days indicator is shown per row.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-016
    statement: The Assigned To filter is pre-applied by default at screen load, scoped to the currently logged-in representative.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-REPO-017
    statement: CSV exports from the Repo Dashboard include Assigned To, Region, Contract State, and Last Worked Date as columns.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-018
    statement: When a note is created from the Repo Dashboard, the system automatically includes a "Repo:" dashboard-source identifier in the note text, visible in note history.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-019
    statement: Queue-ineligible users (Managers, Associate Managers, Team Leads, designated Senior Associates — see specs/modules/common/loss-mitigation/queue-ineligible-users.yaml) retain view and update access to the Repo Dashboard but never receive account assignments.
    priority: High

- id: BR-REPO-021
    statement: |
      The reinstatement limit (max two completed reinstatements) applies only when the account's
      origination state is not a statutory reinstatement state. Statutory exempt states: California,
      Connecticut, Illinois, Maryland, Mississippi, New York, Ohio, Rhode Island, Wisconsin — these
      continue to allow reinstatement regardless of prior reinstatement count. All other origination
      states are subject to the limit.
    priority: Critical
    note: "Per SERV-12207. Illinois is treated the same as other statutory states (blanket exempt)."

- id: BR-REPO-022
    statement: |
      When origination state is non-statutory, the account has two completed reinstatements, and a
      third repossession is recorded, the system automatically creates a Level 1 "Not Eligible for
      Reinstatement" blocker event.
    priority: Critical
    note: "Per SERV-12207."

- id: BR-REPO-023
    statement: |
      The "Not Eligible for Reinstatement" event is Level 1, appears in Account Alerts and Overview
      on UniFi Events (and on RHS Events wherever the shared event component is enabled), triggers
      an automated system note ("This account is not eligible for reinstatement. The maximum
      allowable reinstatement limit has been reached. Full redemption is required per company
      policy."), and cannot be removed from the UI (see event.component.yaml RL-008).
    priority: Critical
    note: "Per SERV-12207."

- id: BR-REPO-024
    statement: |
      If an active "Not Eligible for Reinstatement" event already exists on the account, no duplicate
      event is created; the existing event remains active.
    priority: High
    note: "Per SERV-12207."

- id: BR-REPO-025
    statement: |
      A "Not Eligible for Reinstatement" event is not created when the origination state is a
      statutory reinstatement state, or when the account has fewer than two completed reinstatements
      at the time a repossession is recorded.
    priority: Critical
    note: "Per SERV-12207."
